The clear_buddies function does not seem to play well with the concept
of hierarchical runqueues.  In the following tree
represented by 'G'
(nl)
G(nl)  G
T(l) T(n)  T
This situation can arise when a task is woken up T(n)
running task T(l) is marked last.
When clear_buddies is called from either T(l) or T(n)
buddies of the group G(nl) will be cleared.  This is not the desired
result
column2: since we would like to be able to find the other type of buddy

column1: in many cases.
This especially a worry when implementing yield_task_fair through the
buddy system.
The fix is simple: only clear the buddy type that the task itself
is indicated to be.  As an added bonus
column2: we stop walking up the tree

column1: when the buddy has already been cleared or pointed elsewhere.
